narrowings.why: Where the lane the subject has moved into is no neighbour of the lane left in that lane's direction, the record admits “either indication given for the side the body moves towards”. The side the body moves towards is read by no atom this node claims, so the third limb of the signal requirement accepts either indication — the turn indicator showing left or right, or an arm signal meaning left or right — within the window behind the movement. The duty still requires an indication for such a movement; only which side it names is left open.
